name: How can I stay on budget during an interior home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I stay on budget during an interior home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To stay on budget, establish a realistic budget from the outset and include a contingency fund of 10-20% for unforeseen issues. Make all material and design selections before construction begins to avoid change orders, which can increase costs and extend timelines. Communicate regularly with your contractor about expenses and progress. Prioritize your spending on items that offer the most impact or are difficult to change later, like structural elements or high-quality fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Set a realistic budget, include a contingency, make selections early, and communicate with your contractor.
